property_summary: For every input call to initialize(...) the reference contract accepts any feeRate in [0,5000] (i.e. initialize does not revert and sets feeRate to the provided value); the mutant wrongly rejects feeRate == 0 causing initialize to revert for some admissible input.
change_summary: Insert an extra validation that reverts when _feeRate is zero, preventing feeRate being set to 0 and thus changing observable feeRate when callers pass 0.
